title: Locomotive: headline letters that pick up colour
note: The hero title (Locomotive® / Digital-first Design Agency, 70px narrow serif) sits on the video with mix-blend-mode: difference, so it inverts against whatever is behind it. On top of that, a few single letters, and sometimes whole runs, switch to an accent (cyan #7fe7f2, orange #f39a3c, blue) and back about once a second, so the colour wanders through the words. Built by wrapping each letter in a span and toggling a class on a random few. Worth reusing: colour in two or three letters at a time keeps a black-and-white page alive without colouring a whole headline.
